verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, open export formats, or account-exit path for HubSpot Marketing Hub. The Marketing Emails API GET endpoints retrieve one data type programmatically, and the Salesforce sync is a different integration feature; both are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented 'export all data' capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
